name: ce.debug_control
description: Control Windows or VEH debugger. Start adopts matching active backend; omitting interface uses CE's configured default. Cleanup never resumes or detaches an adopted debugger and remains available. Native stopped truth is refreshed for each status/session and stop guard. stopGeneration guards current native waiting context, not old snapshot lifetime. Pause is process suspension: only run, no register context. Guards are not proof for all architectures or call variants. Remove owned breakpoints before detach.

interface.description: Optional explicit backend. When omitted, use CE's configured default and reject it unless the resulting native interface is Windows or VEH.

action.description: Suspend a running process, not a debugger thread stop. Process suspension supplies no register context and permits only continue mode=run.

mode.description: Native debugger stops use co_run, co_stepinto, or co_stepover after fresh native stop and generation checks. Process suspension permits only run (unpause), not stepping or register context.

expectedStopGeneration.description: Must match the current stopGeneration with native waiting context rechecked; an old snapshot does not establish its continued lifetime. For process suspension, guards only run/unpause, not context or stepping.
